name: TAF Demographic and Eligibility (DE) Base File
description: The TAF Demographic and Eligibility (DE) Base File contains annual, beneficiary-level demographic and enrollment summary information for individuals enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP at any point during the year. One record per beneficiary per state per year.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Demographic and Eligibility Denominator File
description: Annual beneficiary-level file containing demographic characteristics and summary enrollment information for all individuals enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP during the year. Derived from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF) Demographic and Eligibility (DE) segment.

content.bene_id: String: Encrypted Beneficiary ID (CMS encrypted identifier)
content.year: Int32: Reference year of enrollment data
content.death_dt: Date32[day]: Beneficiary date of death (if applicable)
content.age: Int32: Age of beneficiary as of the last day of the reference year
content.sex_cd: String: Sex of the beneficiary (M = Male, F = Female, U = Unknown)
content.race_ethncty_cd: String: Race and ethnicity code (CMS race/ethnicity classification)
content.incm_cd: String: Income code indicating income level relative to the federal poverty level
content.zip_cd: String: 5-digit ZIP code of beneficiary residence
content.cnty_cd: String: County FIPS code of beneficiary residence
content.zcta: String: ZIP Code Tabulation Area mapped from ZIP code
content.dual_elgbl_cd: String: Dual eligibility code indicating Medicare/Medicaid dual enrollment status
content.chip_cd: String: CHIP code indicating whether beneficiary is enrolled in CHIP
content.elgblty_grp_cd: String: Primary eligibility group code for the year
content.mnths_enrolled: Int32: Number of months enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP during the year
content.mnths_dual: Int32: Number of months with dual Medicare/Medicaid eligibility
content.msis_ident_num: String: Medicaid system identifier number assigned by the state
